items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] When did you first meet Jay Jay? [INTERVIEWER] We were playing in the Red Allen band.

ctx.x: I never did know what to think of him. I can't understand nothing but a whole lot of notes.
When did you first meet Jay Jay?
We were playing in the Red Allen band. We were playing at the Three Deuces and he had three pieces there during intermission.
